validity.researcher_notes: DUPLICATE / SEGMENT DOUBLE-COUNT. The roster holds four near-identical Abu Ali<->Berri entries that look like one corridor sliced by an automated import: P1921 Abu Ali->Berri (44 km, 30 in, cap 220), P1922 Berri->Abu Ali (39 km, 8 in), P1923 Berri->Abu Ali (39 km, 10 in), P7768 Abu Ali->Berri / Al Jubail->Berri (22 km, 30 in, cap 220). P1922 and P1923 share the SAME endpoints, SAME 39.00 km length and SAME status -- differing ONLY in diameter (8 vs 10 in). That is the signature of a single right-of-way carrying parallel small lines entered as two separate 'pipelines', or a straight relabel duplicate. P1922 sits inside the contiguous P1897-P1925 block (sequential ProjectIDs, identical formatting, mostly blank capacity) which is itself characteristic of a one-shot bulk ingest rather than independently researched rows. Recommend de-dup review before any spend on refs.
